candidates.basis: 52-week intraday high from adjusted daily bars
candidates.catalyst: Worldwide da Vinci/Ion procedures continue compounding, increasing recurring instruments, accessories and service revenue. da Vinci 5 adoption expands the installed base and can support higher utilization and recurring ecosystem revenue. Ion procedure growth expands Intuitive beyond traditional surgery into minimally invasive lung diagnostics. Digital workflow, analytics and AI-assisted capabilities can deepen hospital integration and switching costs.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation, procedure-growth deceleration, hospital budgets, product competition and tariff/refund variability.
candidates.quality: Q2 GAAP gross margin 67.8% versus 66.3%; operating margin 33.6% versus 30.5%. A $28M tariff refund helped results and must not be extrapolated.
candidates.options: Underlying qualifies. LEAP contract still requires live liquidity, IV, spread, delta and open-interest verification. Target 0.60–0.75 delta, ITM, preferably 18–30 months; no premium/cost cap. Highest OI wins only after an acceptable spread is verified.

quarter.units: USD millions except per-share EPS; most recent quarter first

candidates.down: The stock experienced a major valuation reset from its 52-week high despite continued double-digit procedure, revenue and earnings growth. The setup is valuation compression plus a support/base test rather than a broken earnings story.
candidates.cash: Reconstructed TTM OCF-minus-PPE FCF $3.22B, +61.6%; all four comparable quarters increased. Q2 company release reports $8.63B cash/investments.
candidates.margins: Q2 GAAP gross margin 67.8% versus 66.3%; operating margin 33.6% versus 30.5%. A $28M tariff refund helped results and must not be extrapolated.
candidates.balance: Large cash/investment balance and limited funded debt. Q2 SBC $213M versus $200M, about 7.4% of revenue.
catalysts: Worldwide da Vinci/Ion procedures continue compounding, increasing recurring instruments, accessories and service revenue.
da Vinci 5 adoption expands the installed base and can support higher utilization and recurring ecosystem revenue.
Ion procedure growth expands Intuitive beyond traditional surgery into minimally invasive lung diagnostics.
Digital workflow, analytics and AI-assisted capabilities can deepen hospital integration and switching costs.
candidates.moat: Large installed base, surgeon training, hospital workflow integration, regulatory experience, recurring instruments/accessories, service ecosystem and clinical adoption create substantial switching costs.
candidates.valuation: STILL EXPENSIVE: about 47.5x trailing GAAP EPS and 46.3x reconstructed FCF/share; estimated FCF yield 2.2%. Figures use observed quotes and approximate diluted shares, not live consensus estimates. Falling price does not prove the prior premium multiple will return.

candidates.invalidation: Procedure growth falls materially below the low-teens range, system placements weaken persistently, margins structurally deteriorate, competitive adoption accelerates against Intuitive, or valuation remains excessive relative to growth.
